data.one_liner: Animation wrapper widgets to easily animate child widgets by wrapping them.
data.what_it_does: Provides wrapper widgets like FadedScaleAnimation, FadedSlideAnimation, FadeAnimation, and ScaleAnimation. Developers simply wrap any child widget with these wrappers to add animations.
use_when: You want a quick way to apply common fade and scale animations to widgets without managing controllers.
You prefer wrapper widgets over explicit AnimationControllers for simple widget transitions.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or advanced custom animation orchestration.
You need an animation package that handles complex route transitions.
strengths: Very easy to use by simply wrapping existing widgets.
Includes multiple pre-built animation wrappers like scale and slide fades.
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-defined wrapper animations.
Lacks advanced configuration compared to more comprehensive animation libraries.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a much more powerful and chainable animation api for Flutter widgets.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers ready-to-use bounce and fade animations based on popular CSS animations.

data.minimal_example:
FadedScaleAnimation(
    Container(
        height: 200,
        width: 200,
        color: Colors.blue,
    ),
)
